summary: Incomplete enumerations (--max-pages cap, sticky next-cursor abort, per-page resume checkpoints) must not advance last_synced_at; only a completed page loop (cleared cursor) is a snapshot observation.
reason: movers and designers-deltas key design_snapshots on GetLastSyncedAt. Stamping last_synced_at when pagination is still incomplete — a preserved --max-pages cursor or a repeated next cursor — makes later retries look like new upstream activity (designers deltas NewDesigns) even when MakerWorld data has not changed. --latest-only still stamps because it clears the cursor and treats the head page as a complete observation.
validated_outcome: SaveSyncCheckpoint preserves last_synced_at after SaveSyncState; a first insert is scanable by GetSyncState with a zero watermark that GetLastSyncedAt treats as empty. CLI tests: capped designs sync and sticky-cursor abort keep a prior last_synced_at; completing remaining pages then stamps it.
